reason: A DSH web access plugin that enables LAN or tunneled remote access, with QR-code connection details and an optional login portal for externally reachable deployments.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面提供局域网、cloudflared 或 frp 远程访问，并可显示二维码及启用登录门户。
summaries.en: Provides LAN, cloudflared, or frp remote access to the DSH web interface, with QR-code connection details and an optional login portal.

capabilities: Exposes the DSH web interface to devices on the local network
Manages optional cloudflared and frpc tunnel processes for external access
Modifies host and trust settings to allow remote browser access
Provides an optional password-based login portal and reverse proxy
Displays QR codes and URLs for connecting mobile or other devices
